scope: Requested comma USB power/reboot fix, its boot/owner-restoration follow-ups and adjacent PD/UDC/VM policies. Host Android/iOS/macOS apps remain upstream external clients; this is not a wholesale copy of their applications into the vehicle runtime.

coverage.behavior: Cut input current before gadget setup and from boot for any nonzero setting; retain while wanted; restore only on an empty port; settle failed attempts rather than retrying each poll.

Three bounded DR swaps, one PD reset, source hold/release, UDC start/restart/unplug, existing eGPU exclusion and prior-owner preservation. Upstream optional phone charging policy is preserved in the core; the fork has no charging setting, so daemon input remains false (upstream default).
Once per owner/setting transition; snapshot stock values before changes, restore dirty-ratio mode correctly, independent UDC writes, preserve tuning across a wanted restart.

Temporarily hand over only identity-checked stock AGNOS g1 NCM+ADB with root-owned restoration journal; stop watcher/adbd, unbind g1, restore on disable/setup failure under current AdbEnabled. Unknown foreign owners still retry after 2s without unbinding; other setup failures back off 60s.

intentional_native_adaptations: Rust fixed-path root helper replaces upstream shell/Python runtime calls. Root-owned regular non-symlink VM snapshot is required; an unwritable snapshot aborts tuning before stock settings can be lost.

Fork onroad transport/preparation authorization, model deadlines, recurring-state identity, existing v2/v3 compatibility and CPU scheduling remain in place. Upstream offroad setup gating and network RPS core6 placement are not imported: native controlsd/selfdrived use core6 and worker scheduling is already governed by this fork's measured CPU policy.

Persistent native owner/RPC workers retain their existing process lifecycle rather than importing upstream Python launcher/lender subprocess topology. Existing checked-in protocol reference remains pinned; new power/port oracle fetches and hashes the actual hardware-policy revision separately.

2026-10-22 #487: explicit external-model enable replaces Shadow and the extra activation edge; live model/session/frame/deadline checks and stopped/disengaged handover remain. Historical approval telemetry stays diagnostic, never fabricated. Stock AGNOS ADB handover is a native addition required by the reported g1 collision; original source set_adb.sh at ajouatom/agnos-builder 61073bdd9d92c3695aa54eef4d2c33707a82687f identifies the exact gadget.
